edits.text: 1. Purchase Price. The Buyer shall pay the Seller USD 40,000,000 for the Shares.
2. Closing. Closing shall occur within 45 days of signing, subject to the satisfaction or waiver of customary closing conditions.

3. Representations. The Seller represents that: (a) it has the authority to enter into and perform this Agreement; (b) it has good and valid title to the Shares, free and clear of liens other than any arising under applicable securities laws or this Agreement; (c) there are no material undisclosed liabilities of the Company, other than liabilities incurred in the ordinary course of business since the balance sheet date; (d) the Company is in material compliance with applicable law; and (e) there is no pending or, to the Seller's knowledge, threatened litigation that would materially adversely affect the Company or the transactions contemplated hereby.

4. Confidentiality. The terms of this Agreement are confidential, except to the extent disclosure is required by applicable law or regulation, requested by a regulator, reasonably necessary to obtain financing, or made to the parties' legal, financial, tax, accounting, and other professional advisers who are bound by confidentiality obligations.
